rv.q: These are fairly trivial concerns for a terrific debut play, wonderfully directed, and with a great, hard-working cast.
Across the rest of the traverse stage, those stories are smashed into sharp, rapid-fire scenes, flicked between as if scrolled through on a phone.

cn.t: Dettmer's unflinching debut interrogates our relationship with screen violence in 65 intense minutes of vignettes. Critics find it admirably unafraid and deeply unsettling, though occasionally unsubtle in its fury-filled approach.
